Metadata.title: QwertyRank — Typing speed test
Metadata.description: How fast do you type? Take a 30-second typing test and compare your words per minute.

Home.title: How fast do you type?
Home.aboutTitle: How the typing speed test works
Home.about1: Type the words on screen for 30 seconds, exactly as you see them. When time is up you get your words per minute (WPM): the characters you typed correctly, divided by five, per minute. We also measure your accuracy, the share of keystrokes that were correct.
Home.about2: Each language and keyboard type has its own ranking. Your best game counts as long as its accuracy is at least 90%, and the server works out whether you typed on a physical or a touch keyboard. You need an account to enter the ranking; you can play without one and save your game if you sign in within 10 minutes.
Home.about3: Want to warm up first? The <practice>15-second practice</practice> has no ranking and starts as soon as you type.
Home.about4: Want to improve? Read our <guides>typing guides</guides>.
